text:
Maya (CSM): Heads-up: ACME Retail renewal ~6 weeks out. Dashboard flagged them as RED — usage down ~65% last 30d, key seats inactive. We need a quick save plan and a downgrade path if engagement doesn't recover.
Jorge (CS Ops): Copy. Can you drop the last 30d KPI snapshot? I'll pull feature-usage and API error rates.
ops-bot: [ALERT] account: acme-retail — 65% drop in active sessions (30d) · renewal_date=2026-05-07 · health=red
Priya (Onboarding): I noticed they never completed the integrations checklist: SSO pending + webhooks not confirmed. We had 2 scheduled enablement sessions but only 1 attended.
Maya (CSM): TL;DR: low adoption + partial onboarding -> churn risk. Proposed short play: 1) Outreach + 1:1 ops workshop this week; 2) Targeted usage plan (sample prompts, templates, 4 free expert hours); 3) Downgrade-swap path if still at risk at T-2w.
Liam (AM): +1 to workshop. I'll join the customer call if we can get it scheduled for Friday. Can we offer a temporary credits bump to encourage trialing the new templates?
Jorge (CS Ops): I'll run queries tonight. Quick SQL I use: 
```sql
SELECT feature, count(distinct user_id) as active_users
FROM events
WHERE account_id='acme-retail' AND ts > now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY feature
ORDER BY active_users DESC;
```
Will post results by EOD.
Priya (Onboarding): Draft outreach note to send after we confirm timeslot: "Hi Sarah — quick check-in: noticed a drop in activity; we'd like to run a hands-on session focused on integrating templates + SSO so your team can get value faster. Available Fri 11am or Mon 10am? We'll also share quick wins for your engineers." Thoughts?
Maya (CSM): Good. Add: "We'll pre-populate 3 high-impact prompts tailored to your catalog." Also: assign owners: @Priya run workshop logistics, @Jorge deliver usage snapshot + one-pager on quick fixes, @Liam coordinate commercial sweetener (2 weeks free or credits). I'll lead the call and update the renewal play in Notion.
Jorge (CS Ops): Noted. I'll add a mini runbook: check SSO SAML settings, webhook delivery logs, and model throttling. If we see >5% 500s in API, escalate to eng-runtime.
Maya (CSM): Downgrade path outline (if they request): a) offer a smaller seat package with data retention guarantee; b) auto-fallback to standard model tier (no quantization) with price protection for 3 months; c) scheduled re-onboarding check at T+30. Keep this as last resort.
Priya (Onboarding): I'll attach our playbook link and the customer-facing template after the workshop: https://company-notion.internal/cs/playbooks/save-play-templates
Liam (AM): I'll prepare a short commercial note. If they accept credits, let's tie it to a joint success milestone (e.g., +20% active sessions).
Maya (CSM): Next steps: Priya to confirm workshop time by EOD, Jorge to post usage snapshot, Liam to propose credit amount. We'll reconvene in this thread after the call. Thanks all :thumbsup:
